scripts.dev: npm run build -w @health/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @health/api" "npm run dev -w @health/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @health/contracts && npm run build -w @health/api && npm run build -w @health/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @health/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @health/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
